title: The Pace of AI Progress
tagline: Takeoff — draw your forecast of machine capability, then watch the real curves land
hub_blurb: Draw your own capability forecasts, reveal the measured curves, and inspect the successes, failures, and sources behind them.
card_blurb: Five benchmarks: draw where you think machine capability went, then see the truth animate over your line. A timeline of 124 model releases, six domains of real-world evidence plus an Elsewhere round-up — with the failures and overclaims kept in frame — and every number backed by a source.
description: **The Pace of AI Progress** (folder `takeoff/`; "Takeoff" in the hub, "Undershoot" in the internal module names) — a phone-first, single-file presentation about machine capability since ChatGPT. The audience draws five benchmark forecasts before the real curves are revealed, explores a timeline of 124 model releases, and examines evidence across biology, medicine, weather, materials, mathematics, and software — with failures and overclaims kept beside the results. Every number resolves to a local source. A Guide overlay opens on every load; Settings offers Open Presenter Notes, Presentation mode and Reset; and the presenter notes are not a summary of the printable guide but the guide itself, injected at build time from one canonical file that also produces the shipped HTML and the PDF, with a --check that fails on drift.
